title: Gate evaluation modulo an integer
statement: Let $n,k\in\mathbb{N}$, let $a:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$, and let $v$ be a list of natural numbers such that every entry of $v$ is less than $k$. For every arithmetic gate $g$ with $n$ possible input variables, evaluating its natural-number gate value modulo $k$ gives the same element of $\mathbb{Z}/k\mathbb{Z}$ as evaluating the gate over $\mathbb{Z}/k\mathbb{Z}$ on the input values obtained by reducing $a(i)$ modulo $k$.
hypotheses_covered: Every entry of $v$ is less than $k$
$g$ is an arithmetic gate with $n$ possible input variables
